longLivedTangibleAssets.label: Long-lived tangible assets (net book value)
longLivedTangibleAssets.definition: Net book value of long-lived tangible assets located in the U.S. versus outside the U.S. (the majority of the latter in Taiwan and the rest of the Asia-Pacific region).

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Note 8, Segment Information
source.quote: The net book value of long-lived tangible assets located in the U.S. was $ 1.9 billion and $ 2.0 billion at September 29, 2024 and September 24, 2023, respectively.

regions.name: Outside the U.S. (mostly Taiwan and the rest of Asia-Pacific)

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Note 8, Segment Information
source.quote: The net book value of long-lived tangible assets located outside of the U.S. (the majority of which is located in Taiwan and the rest of the Asia-Pacific region) was $ 3.5 billion and $ 3.6 billion at September 29, 2024 and September 24, 2023, respectively.

sites.name: Headquarters
sites.description: Headquarters and certain research and development and network management hub operations.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our headquarters and certain of our research and development and network management hub operations are located in San Diego, California.

source.label: 2024 Corporate Responsibility Report, environmental data table, footnote 38
source.quote: Based on the WRI Water Aqueduct ToolTM, the area where our manufacturing facility in Wuxi is located is high baseline for water scarcity in 2024.

notes: Qualcomm publishes no state, country or regional employee breakdown: the FY2024 10-K says ~49,000 workers 'working in over 150 locations in 37 different countries', and the 2024 Corporate Responsibility Report gives only a total (49,336 workers). Item 2 gives facilities only as U.S. 5.3m vs other countries 8.8m square feet (square footage is not a lens unit) and names owned and leased manufacturing in China, Germany and Singapore and R&D centers primarily in the United States, India and China, with new facilities under construction in India. The only country split with a value is long-lived tangible assets (U.S. $1.9bn vs outside the U.S. $3.5bn). Revenue by customer headquarters country is in the records and not repeated. No taxes-by-country report was found.
